# Nagachethana PU College

> Nagachethana PU College (College Code: AN0928) is a recognised pre-university college in Yelahanka, North Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. Established in 2015 by Mrs. G. Jayalakshmi, it offers Science (PCMB/PCMC) and Commerce (CEBA/HEBA) PUC streams with integrated NEET, KCET, and JEE coaching. It serves 1,000+ students with 50+ faculty and a 98% board pass rate.

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2015 | First batch: 2016
- College Code: AN0928 (Department of Pre-University Education, Government of Karnataka)
- Address: Near Raithara Santhe, Behind KIA Car Showroom, Old Town, Yelahanka, Bengaluru 560064, Karnataka, India
- Phone: +91 97390 85747 | Email: npucan928@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM
- Results: 98% pass rate, 50+ toppers, 2,000+ graduates
- Rating: 4.8/5 (105 Google reviews)

## Streams

- Science: PCMB, PCMC (with integrated NEET/KCET/JEE coaching)
- Commerce: CEBA, HEBA

## Frequently Asked Questions

- When was Nagachethana PU College founded? It was founded in 2015 in Yelahanka, Bengaluru, Karnataka.
- Is Nagachethana PU College government or private? It is a private, government-recognised PU college under the Karnataka Department of Pre-University Education.
- Which board does Nagachethana PU College follow? It follows the Karnataka PUC (Pre-University Course) syllabus of the Department of Pre-University Education.
- What streams are offered? Science (PCMB and PCMC) and Commerce (CEBA and HEBA).
- What are the college timings? Office hours are Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
- What is the pass rate? The college consistently achieves a 98% pass rate in Karnataka PUC board examinations.
